name: Korseg IV
description: Korseg IV was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Grohl sector. During the Galactic Civil War, the Rebel Alliance maintained a base there that was discovered and attacked by a ground force of the Galactic Empire. In the ensuing battle, the Alliance emerged victorious.
